result:
"For years, the fabric of time has remained an enigmatic tapestry, weaving stories that go beyond the grasp of our tangible reality. It has been the core of human existence, defining our lives and shaping our relationships, our moments, memories, and the inevitable flow of our existence. Yet, it is within these threads that lie dance and death, love and loss, miracles and sufferings. It is the silent observer of our greatest joys and sorrows, a chronological tome brimming with our tales and moments etched in the undying annals of our collective memory. We often forget that our existence is but a fleeting whisper in its embrace, and the span of time a silent spectator that continues beyond our momentary presence. The philosophical ponderings of why we exist or what awaits beyond our confines are testimonies to our insatiable curiosity. Life's enchantment lies not only in its beauties but also in the passing; every goodbye and the mightiness of nature's planets in cosmic dance is a testament to time's endless flow. We dwell in a world of intersections like orchards, where every tree we plant bears the fruit of the past, present, and tomorrow. Our lives are but a sacred interplay between these chords, as integral to the symphony of existence as the writer's pen is to the story. Time, the baton of life, dances through every etching upon the ground, is as delicate as it is powerful, spinning a web that connects the poignant melodies of existence. Immortality, while an inconceivable desire, might perhaps lie not in enduring, but in the legacy we create, the time imprinted in our deeds and hearts that resonate through childrens' dreams and generations yet unborn.

Time, painting our shores with hues of gold, also blurs our vision, steeping each second in familiarity, steeping the dew-kissed moments in unfathomable oblivion. It sculpts mountains from mere sand and erodes the vivid hills to sands undistinguishable. With the blink of an eye, love morphs, mountains recede, and time loses its sharp edges, cradling our lives to a tender murmur of a veiled whisper, a reiteration of an echo in the abyss. Time’s profound authority, our silent companion, kin, patiently orchestrates our existence in unfathomable rhythm. The sun charts a celestial ballet across the eons, father of seasons, ever-evident of our transience against eternity.

The passage of time poses the enduring dilemma; once discerned, we strive for it, seeking solace in narrating its eloquence. Some seek to harness its flow, cradling dreams in a little more time as others relish each stolen moment, their souls imprinted with deep-seated in the core. In skimming the cosmos' pivoting narrative, one finds life's pulse within the honeyed tick-tock and relentless pace, finding worth in every second, every break of dawn and dusk, each twilight of a day. Time mirrors a reverse baton - it quickens our impulses one moment, soothes the next, unveiling universes nested in decipherable particles and rattling seconds. As we walk our paths under Time's stern gaze, we learn to bask in the infinitesimal brilliance of our existence, appreciating an unfettered kinship in permanence and impermanence. In the dance, we're the puppeteer and the puppet, choreographing dances with destiny. Time is more than an impersonal ruler demanding obedience; it's a universal painter, at times, a caring mother, and occasionally a lover. 

Sprawling beneath this temporal canopy, we weave epics of survival, etching emotions, grains of time that reconstruct and repair damages, replicate strengths, and appoint borders. We commit to the fabric with bonds of endearing affection that neither comprehend nor emancipate the totality of our mortal encumbrances. They are fervent, futile imprints of our indomitable spirits. Gradually, the maelite-coated mist of time sears as the winter thaws, but love defies frost's cruelty. Utterly, it's in the blind understanding that outlives us, an unconquerable mountains' station against Time's incursions. Oftentimes, death’s hourglass pins us between salt and pepper grains of youth and wisdom, flickering a flame that illuminates our hearts with the joys we cherished, the pleasures we savored, the moments imbued with the profound rays of unforgotten emotions.

In the undulating tillage of time, some weathers rest in the pink hue of eternity’s solstice, relishing the Novas' brilliance, while others savor but a few instants before Time propels them into oblivion. But, irrespective of the balance, equally fervent battles are waged between Time's courage and frailty. The inherent narrative lies in our naked dystopias and victories, the intertwined chaos and beauty we hold dear, fostering myriad tales of vibrant bloom and shadow offspring. Each heartbeat, a tick; every passing day is an ageless tale in the library of Time, immense and infinite. Time does not merely age, but rather molds us into the sculptures of our perception. It's the paradoxical paradox that etches us anew even as it gradually fades our physical shell, yet ushers ego into glistening spacings of wisdom, a testament to our fabric's resilience. The wheel of Time spins tirelessly, bestowing upon us both the balm of tranquility and turbulent storms, the purgatory for grief and elation. We are simply mortals, standing in tremendous awe, observing, as Life dances intricate ballets, scripted and yet unnoticed on Time’s grand stage - an arbiter of chance, an ally to growth, the great equalizer.

It's in exchanging experiences and traversing spaces in the clutch of Time that life imbibes us a recurrent philosophy, mirrored in millions; each has been etched in countless chronicles across multislice spectra. It beckons us to voyage across the vast expanse kicking venerable shadows of relics from time long past, remonstrating our fleeting existence in life's elaborate theatre, the stage turning on the axis of threads ticking—each one unique. A symphony that sings of the ages. Time, the great author, persistently scripts our tales, wordlessly adorning our ephemeral lives with an enduring lifeblood. Humanity, existing in the heartbeats of Time, blooms in its ceaseless echo, a pulsating melody of transition and transformation that whispers in the wind and echoes in cosmic corridors, engaging an introspective reverie. As we become its conscious imprints, we start recognizing Time’s endless march as our tune. It is for this primal connection, resisting decorum's coy simulacrum, that Time ceases to be an axis of anonymity, a mere participe in life’s grand orchestration—it evolves into an incurable essence of our primordial existence--the sheer epitome of primordial existence."
